name: research-harness
description: ResearchStudio idea_spark on two native-tool surfaces. Claude Code keeps the isolated-seat workflow and adds a host adapter that uses native Web/GitHub retrieval for Phase 0 and Phase 3.1 with an upstream Python-connector fallback. OpenAI ships one prompt-preserving Skill for ChatGPT and Codex with GitHub, web, and Files retrieval plus deterministic Python state/validation helpers.
